# National Veteran's Organization Donor Report

Prepare session

```{r}
remove(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)
donors <- read_csv("donors.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Initial Inspection

Familiarize

```{r}
# Inspect column names
col_names <- colnames(donors) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rename(Columns = "colnames(donors)") |> 
  arrange(Columns)
col_names

# Column types
col_types <- data.frame(
  col_name = names(donors),
  col_type = sapply(donors, class),
  row.names = NULL) |> 
  arrange(col_type)
col_types

# Summarise dataset
summary(donors)

# Inspect NAs
col_NA <- colSums(is.na(donors)) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rename(NA_Count = "colSums(is.na(donors))") |> 
  arrange(desc(NA_Count))
col_NA

total_donors <- nrow(donors)
col_NA_prop <- col_NA |> 
  mutate(NA_Prop = round(NA_Count / total_donors,2))
col_NA_prop
```

## Cleaning

Ensure clean character data

```{r}
# State data overview
summary(donors$state)
class(donors$state)

# State unique values
count_states <- length(unique(donors$state))
count_states # 57 tells us there is either misspelling, or non-domestic states

# Compare the state codes from the dataset with built-in R state codes
state_codes <- c(unique(donors$state))
non_state_terr <- c(setdiff(state_codes, state.abb))
non_state_terr

# Identify non-US-state territories
donors1 <- donors |> 
  mutate(
    isState = !(state %in% non_state_terr),
    .after = state) |> 
  mutate(state = as.factor(state))
class(donors1$state)

# Urbanicity data overview
summary(donors1$urbanicity)
class(donors1$urbanicity)

# Urbanicity unique values
unique(donors1$urbanicity)

# Convert urbanicity to factor
donors2 <- donors1 |>
  mutate(urbanicity = as.factor(urbanicity))
donors2

# Inspect gender
unique(donors2$gender)
class(donors2$gender)

# Convert gender to factor
donors3 <- donors2 |> 
  mutate(gender = as.factor(gender))
donors3

# Inspect socio-economic status
summary(donors3$socioEconomicStatus)
unique(donors3$socioEconomicStatus)
class(donors3$socioEconomicStatus)

# Convert socioEconomicStatus to factor
donors_cl <- donors3 |> 
  mutate(socioEconomicStatus = as.factor(socioEconomicStatus))

donors_cl[c("state", "urbanicity", "socioEconomicStatus","gender")]

# Clear up space in memory
remove(donors, donors1, donors2, donors3)
```

Major aggregates and visualizations

```{r}
# Donor age parameters
avg_age <- round(mean(donors_cl$age, na.rm = T),1)
med_age <- median(donors_cl$age, na.rm = T)
# Inner 90% of values
trim_avg_age <- round(mean(donors_cl$age, trim = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

age_paras <- data.frame(
  metric = c('Mean', 'Trimmed Mean', 'Median'),
  value = c(avg_age, trim_avg_age, med_age))

age_paras


```
